items.title: Paul Beaulieu Interview, 1960-06-11
items.q: And the one that played my good friend, Alon Metwiler.

ctx.x: He was the one you told us about. Yeah. He was an excellent fruitist. And did they ever tell you about Alcibiad Jean-Jacques? No, I don't think so. Alcibiad Jean-Jacques was a corner player. I don't know who he studied with. He must have studied with one something Frenchman. Because most of them, they got from those Frenchmen that came there with the opera. He must have studied with them. And he went away with a show. And when he came back, I never knew him. I never heard him before he left. But when he came…
I don't remember. It's a religious song. I've seen the music. Yeah, I know what you mean.
